metcon.name: Workout
metcon.description:
For TIme (40min CAP)
Working in teams of 3
2 working 1 resting
Athlete 1 accumulates meters on the row
Athlete 2 rounds of barbell
athlete 3 rest
transition between full rounds & row as required
8,000m/6,500 Row
& 35 Rounds
9 x Deadlifts
7 x Hang Power Clean
5 x Front Squats
3 x HSPU
Once one station is finished, complete the remaining work, with only one athlete working at that station at a time.

hypertrophy.reasoning: Address posterior chain imbalances and shoulder health while avoiding CNS fatigue from heavy row/squat/clean stimulus.
